d: We are an Exchange & Crypto Custody newly licensed virtual asset service provider (VASP). It is authorized by the UAE Capital Market Authority to operate a virtual asset trading platform and provide custody of client virtual assets.

The Compliance Officer will build and lead a compliance framework that meets the new CMA regime from day one. The role is the firm's main contact with the CMA. It provides independent oversight so that the exchange and custody operations stay within their license conditions, protect client assets, and prevent financial crime.
Set up, keep current and enforce the compliance framework, policies and procedures under CMA Decision and the related CMA rulebooks.
Monitor the license conditions for exchange and custody activities, including capital and liquidity requirements and restrictions on permitted activities.
Run the virtual asset assessment process for Green List registration before any token is listed or offered to clients.
Track regulatory change from the CMA, the UAE FIU, the Central Bank and FATF. Turn it into policy and system updates.
Make sure the firm avoids prohibited products, such as privacy tokens and algorithmic tokens, and gets prior CMA approval where the rules require it.
Oversee the firm's AML/CFT programme under the UAE AML/CFT law as or supervise the MLRO, as the firm's structure requires.
Govern customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), PEP and high-risk customer onboarding.
Oversee blockchain analytics, on-chain transaction monitoring and wallet screening.
Ensure Travel Rule compliance for virtual asset transfers.
Run continuous sanctions screening against UAE, UN, OFAC and EU lists.
File suspicious transaction and activity reports (STRs and SARs) with the UAE FIU through goAML.
Oversee the controls that segregate client virtual assets and fiat from the firm's own assets.
Review hot, warm and cold wallet governance, key management, reconciliations and proof-of-reserves processes with Operations and IT Security.
Review custody incidents, breaks and losses, and escalate them to management and the CMA as required.
Design and deliver a risk-based compliance monitoring plan, including market abuse and trade surveillance on the platform.
Prepare periodic regulatory returns, compliance reports to the Board and notifications to the CMA.
Keep records for at least five years and make sure they are ready for audit.
Act as the main contact for the CMA during inspections, information requests and approval applications.
Coordinate approved-person and fit-and-proper applications for controlled functions.
Advise senior management on new products, token listings, marketing material and business changes.
Lead the firm-wide compliance and AML training programme.
Work with internal and external auditors and track remediation actions to closure.
Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business or a related field.
At least 10 years in compliance, AML or regulatory roles within regulated financial services, with 5+ years at a senior or head-of-function level.
Direct experience with UAE onshore regulation under the SCA, now the CMA, including regulatory filings, inspections and approved-person processes.
At least 3 years in virtual assets, crypto exchange, custody or fintech compliance.
Strong working knowledge of UAE AML/CFT laws, goAML reporting, FATF standards, Travel Rule requirements and targeted financial sanctions.
Able to meet CMA fit-and-proper criteria and be approved for a controlled function.
A professional certification such as ICA Diploma, CAMS, CAMS-FCI, CCAS (Certified Crypto asset Anti-Financial Crime Specialist), CFE or CISI.
Exposure to other virtual asset regimes, such as VARA, ADGM FSRA or DFSA.
Experience with blockchain analytics tools, such as Chainalysis, Elliptic or TRM Labs.
Experience setting up a compliance function at a new licensee.
Sound regulatory judgement, with the independence to challenge the business when needed.
Able to turn complex rules into practical controls for a fast-moving crypto business.
Clear written and verbal communication with regulators, the Board and technical teams.
Understanding of blockchain, wallet infrastructure and digital asset market structure.
High integrity, discretion and attention to detail.
Hands-on and able to build a function from the ground up.
